beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:23.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com/ is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. About the Role Beacon Software buys businesses. You get to grow them. This can take almost any shape. Here are real projects our team ran over the last few months: - Launched ads across Meta and Google. - Ran a full outbound process (leadgen, copywriting, outreach) on behalf of a sales team. - Vibecoded an interactive TAM map to figure out which states and provinces to prioritize. - Designed and launched landing pages. - Built a system to flag high-dollar accounts at risk of churning. - Cross-sold into other portfolio companies. - Gameplanned a conference. - Prototyped a programmatic SEO strategy. - (And much more!) Want some industry jargon? You’ll be a fractional head of growth (a forward-deployed GTM engineer?) who goes deep into portfolio companies and brainstorms, prioritizes, and executes on growth experiments. We’re looking for an animal who can go into a business, ask the right questions with little context, launch experiments, and drive revenue. Basically, we’re looking for The Wolf https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yOZB6mNqhuA, but for growth. Why would you want this role? - Get a first-person view into the world of private equity, rollups, and AI. - Access proprietary learnings about vertical SaaS businesses in a variety of industries. - Work with a team of former YC founders, growth leaders, and execs at Silicon Valley’s fastest-growing companies like Instacart, AngelList, Coinbase, and Retool. - Have loads of control and autonomy over what you work on. - Be artsy AND sciencey. - Like writing copy and brainstorming video ideas? You get to do that. - Like reading investment memos and deeply understanding businesses? You get to do that, too. - Go deep and broad. - We have an $8M ARR company that we think can get to $100M with intelligent performance marketing. - We also have a $1M ARR company that has never had a formal growth strategy. - Spend an ample LLM token budget. - Earn meaningful equity in a hyperscaler that’s already profitable. Who are you? You’re probably one of these: - A growth hire at a startup who wants to get back to early-stage work and ship things. - A former founder who took their company from 0 to 1. - An agency owner or growth consultant sick of doing their own BD, but who enjoys the day-to-day work. (Run an agency? We’re open to acquihiring your team!) Additionally: - You write clearly and concisely. - You’ve cracked a growth channel or loop before. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ef552373-31ac-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate, Hedge Advisory & Analytics based in the United States. This is an opportunity to join a specialized team supporting institutional clients through sophisticated hedging analytics and trading recommendations. The role focuses primarily on mortgage servicing rights and requires strong quantitative and financial expertise. You will analyze market exposures, contribute to valuation models, and translate complex findings into actionable client recommendations. You will also help enhance analytics tools and data systems as market conditions and client needs evolve. The position offers meaningful exposure to interest rate derivatives and real-world financial risk management. Success requires close collaboration across teams, strong client communication, and a high degree of analytical rigor. This fully remote role is well suited to an analytical professional looking to deepen their expertise in financial markets and advisory services. Interface directly with institutional clients on a regular basis, understanding their needs and communicating analytical findings and recommendations clearly. Run hedge analyses as required to evaluate exposures, market conditions, and potential hedging strategies, primarily within the mortgage servicing rights environment. Provide trading and hedging recommendations based on quantitative analysis, market dynamics, and client objectives. Contribute to the development, enhancement, and ongoing maintenance of valuation models, ensuring methodologies remain aligned with industry practices and evolving client requirements. Collaborate with colleagues across multiple teams to explain analytical methodologies, support model and system integration, and ensure effective delivery of solutions. Help maintain and improve related analytics models and data systems while applying strong standards of accuracy, integrity, and technical competency. Participate in additional projects, training, and related responsibilities as business needs evolve. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, statistics, mathematics, business administration, or a comparable combination of education and professional experience. At least 3 years of professional experience in an analyst-level role, ideally within financial markets, risk management, quantitative analytics, mortgage finance, or a related field. Demonstrated understanding of interest rate derivatives and their application to financial hedging strategies. Experience with at least one programming or analytical language such as VBA, Python, C++, or SQL. Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to work with complex financial data and models. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical methodologies to clients and cross-functional stakeholders. Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with a professional approach to working directly with institutional clients. CFA, FRM, or Series 65 certification is considered an advantage. High attention to detail, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to accuracy, integrity, and client service. Benefits: Annual base salary range of $110,000–$150,000 , with actual compensation determined by experience, education, skills, location, and market considerations. Potential eligibility for a discretionary bonus, subject to applicable program guidelines and position eligibility. Fully remote work arrangement. Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays. Medical, dental, and vision insurance. Life and disability insurance. 401(k) retirement plan. Opportunities to develop expertise in hedge analytics, mortgage servicing rights, valuation modeling, and financial markets. msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The Compensation Analyst at Madison Square Garden Entertainment is responsible for the administration of various compensation programs including, but not limited to, reviewing job descriptions and completing job evaluations for various business groups across the organization, generating reports and analyses on a regular and ad-hoc basis, providing insights to support salary decisions and employee retention, participation in annual salary surveys and assisting with executive compensation support. The incumbent must be self-motivated, analytical, and thrive on solving problems while delivering high quality results. What will you do? · Conduct market research and reference salary surveys to determine industry pay standards for roles across the organization.
